kaution_target_workflow:
TARGET KAUTION WORKFLOW (Rentals and Casa Castel use the same steps; the Kaution card is shared)

1. CONTRACT (no change). The Kaution comes from the rule in kaution.js: 3x Kalt, 3x Pauschale, 3x for parking and Gewerbe, and 1x for a Kurzzeit stay of up to 3 months. Approve fixes it as "Kaution Soll". If a tenant gives a Bürgschaft or bank guarantee instead of cash, set Kaution Soll to 0. Nothing is held, so nothing is counted.

2. MOVE-IN. The tenant transfers the Kaution to the separate Kautionskonto (§ 551 BGB). On the Kaution card you enter "Received" and the date. Controlling: nothing. A Kaution is never typed into a rent month.

3. DURING THE TENANCY. The Kaution is not touched. Every NK result goes the normal way: letter, bank transfer (the tenant pays you or you pay back), then "Received" / "Paid back" books it in Controlling in the month the money moved. There is no "with the rent" and no "via Kaution" choice any more.

4. MOVE-OUT, on the Kaution card ("Settle"), in one form:
   - "Kept · other reasons" + Reason (rent owed, damages, cleaning).
   - "Kept · for NK-Abrechnung". Shown only for tenants who get an NK-Abrechnung. Keep a reasonable amount, e.g. the last Nachzahlung plus a margin, or 3-4 months of NK prepayment.
   - "Refund to tenant" = the rest. A refund you typed stays as typed.
   - "Settled on" = the day the refund went out by bank transfer. Also fill it when the refund is 0 €.
   After Save the card says "Settled · 300 € held for NK", and "Kaution held" keeps the 300 € until that NK is done. Controlling: nothing.

5. SAME DAY, the part kept for other reasons goes where it belongs (recommended answer to open question 1):
   - Unpaid rent month: Controlling › Income, enter that month as received. It is rent paid by the Verrechnung, and its NK part then counts as prepayment in the tenant's last NK-Abrechnung.
   - Damage: Maintenance receipt › Who pays › Schaden › Direct, paid on that day. This works in Casa today and in Rentals once D40 is built.

6. NK-ABRECHNUNG of the move-out year, within 12 months after the period ends (§ 556 (3) BGB). Settlements takes the held 300 € by itself, in the first NK letter of that tenant sent after the Kaution was settled. There is no choice to make. The letter offsets the 300 € and names the one bank transfer that is left:
   - Nachzahlung 200: 100 € are transferred back to the tenant.
   - Nachzahlung 450: the tenant transfers the rest, 150 €.
   - Guthaben 50: 350 € are transferred back.
   - Balanced: the 300 € are transferred back.
   Mark as sent. Controlling now shows the NK result as an open Soll (+200 / +450 / −50). It is not counted yet.

7. MONEY STEP = THE REAL TRANSFER. The step names what really moves: "You pay back 100,00 €", "Lena transfers 150,00 €", "You pay back 350,00 €" or "You pay back 300,00 €". It has the date and the amount, prefilled. Tap "Paid back" / "Received" once the money has moved. Controlling then books ONE line in that month: the kept part plus or minus that transfer, i.e. +200 / +450 / −50, and nothing in the balanced case. The Kaution money going back is never booked.
   - If the tenant pays only 100 of the 150 €: type 100, and +400 counts.
   - If he never pays: confirm 0. The 300 € kept count, and the missing 150 € stays visible as the difference.

8. DONE. With that NK settled, the hold is used up. The Kaution card and "Kaution held" show nothing left, and Archive is possible.
   - "undo" on the Money step only takes back the booking. The line stays "via Kaution", and the 300 € stay used once.

9. PAUSCHAL / KURZZEIT PAUSCHAL / PARKING. There is no NK-Abrechnung, so the card has no "Kept · for NK" field. Everything is settled on the card at move-out: refund by transfer, kept rent or damages as in step 5.

10. NK NOT DONE IN TIME. If the 12-month Frist passes without an NK letter, you can no longer claim a Nachzahlung. The held part goes back to the tenant by transfer: add it to the refund on the Kaution card. Nothing is counted.

controlling_rule_table.counts_in_controlling: 0 € in every month. Never in Income, Expenses, cashflow, Dashboard or export (R1).

controlling_rule_table.counts_in_controlling: 0 €. The interest is the tenant's (§ 551 (3) BGB).

Part held for the NK-Abrechnung (e.g. 300 €), the rest refunded, waiting for the NK

+450 € Income (300 kept + 150 received), in the month the 150 € arrive. If only 100 € arrive: +400 €. If nothing arrives and you confirm 0: +300 €.
+300 € Income, in the month you confirm it (nothing moves by bank).
−50 € Expenses › Abrechnungen, in the month of the 350 € transfer. The 300 € = Kaution = 0 €.

No Kaution held (active tenant, or Kaution already refunded): NK Nachzahlung 200 € / Guthaben 50 €
controlling_rule_table.counts_in_controlling: Bank transfer only: +200 € Income in the month received / −50 € Expenses in the month paid back (as today).

controlling_rule_table.counts_in_controlling: +1.000 € as rent in the September rent row (Kalt + NK split; the NK part counts as prepayment in the tenant's NK-Abrechnung). You enter it on the day you keep it. Before that, September shows 'missing' and counts 0 € (recommended option A of open question 1).

controlling_rule_table.counts_in_controlling: Same as move-in / refund (0 €), and kept rent or damage as above. There is never an NK hold (no NK-Abrechnung).

consultant_notes:
WHY THE OWNER RULES MAKE SENSE
- R1 matches the law and the tax return. § 551 (3) BGB says the Kaution must be kept apart from the landlord's own money, and its interest belongs to the tenant. A Kaution received or paid back is not income in Anlage V. Keeping it out of Controlling is correct.
- R2 matches when money really becomes the owner's. A kept part becomes income when it is offset ("verrechnet"), not when it is held. Booking ONE line (kept part ± the real transfer) on the day the rest moves gives exactly the owner's figures: +200 / +450 / −50.
- R3 is legally safer, not only simpler.
  - During the tenancy the landlord should not use the Kaution to pay an NK Nachzahlung. It is security, and the BGH does not allow it for disputed claims while the tenancy runs. Today's free "via Kaution" invites exactly that.
  - After move-out there is no "next rent".
  - "With the rent" also corrupts data: the money is split into Kalt and NK and shifts the next NK-Abrechnung (December 277,04 € instead of 185 €).
- Holding part of the Kaution is lawful. The BGH (VIII ZR 71/05) lets the landlord keep a reasonable part until the NK-Abrechnung when a Nachzahlung is expected.
  - "Reasonable" means roughly the last Nachzahlung plus a margin, or 3-4 months of NK prepayment, not the whole Kaution.
  - The hold must go back at the latest when the 12-month Frist of § 556 (3) BGB has passed without an Abrechnung.
- R4: the only Kaution link left is the card's "Kept · for NK-Abrechnung", which Settlements reads by itself. The card never writes to Controlling. Settlements never writes to the Kaution. No SQL is needed: only the existing values 'zahlung' and 'kaution' are written.

SIDE EFFECTS THE OWNER SHOULD KNOW
1. Old results stay as stored.
   - NK results settled "with the rent" stay grey and count 0 €. That is right, because their money is already in the rent Ist. Their NK part may have shifted that year's NK prepayment, so check those tenants' next NK-Abrechnung once. Read-only list: select app, year, tenant_name, direction, amount from abr_results where settle_via = 'miete' and status <> 'storniert';
   - Rent months marked "On purpose · Kaution" keep their mark; fix them by hand. Read-only list: select * from ctrl_income_months where diff_reason = 'kaution';
   - Old "via Kaution" results: see open question 2.
2. WEG "with the Hausgeld". R3 cannot bind the WEG, which offsets as it likes. The app already uses bank transfer for the WEG and "type 0 € if offset with the Hausgeld". The lower Hausgeld payment then shows in the Hausgeld Ist, so nothing is lost. Older records stored "with the Hausgeld" are fixed by C4 (bug KAU-12).
3. Tenant does not pay the rest. The 300 € kept count only when you confirm the Money step. If the 150 € never come, confirm 0: +300 € counts, and the 150 € stay visible as the open difference.
4. Which NK uses the hold: the first NK letter of that tenant sent after the Kaution was settled. If the previous year's NK is still open at move-out, that letter uses the hold and sends the rest back. The final year must then be collected by transfer from a former tenant. Send the older NK before you settle the Kaution if you can.
5. Frist passed. If the NK cannot be sent in time, give the held part back by transfer: add it to the refund on the Kaution card. Nothing is counted.
6. Kurzzeit / Pauschal rooms have no NK-Abrechnung, so there is no hold. A 1x Kaution for a short stay covers only rent owed, cleaning or damage, settled at move-out. Kurzzeit Pauschal with 0 € "davon NK" stays allowed (CLAUDE.md).
7. Bürgschaft.
   - The app stores nothing about a guarantee. If it replaces the cash Kaution, set Kaution Soll to 0, otherwise the card shows "Kaution open" and blocks Archive. Money drawn from a guarantee counts as the claim it pays (rent or NK), when received.
   - Casa's Mietbürgschaft page says the guarantee comes on top of a full 3x Kaution. The § 551 cap of 3 Kaltmieten applies to all securities together, unless the guarantor offered it unasked. Worth a quick check with Haus & Grund.
   - The cap is fine for Casa Pauschal contracts: they say "inkl. NK" with no separate NK amount, so 3x the Pauschale is allowed. It would only matter if a contract showed the NK part separately.
8. Interest on the Kautionskonto belongs to the tenant and is never counted. The card refuses a refund above Received, so it tracks the Kaution only, not the interest. Pay the interest as the bank shows it.
9. Rent owed and damages kept (open question 1). Recommended: enter them where they belong.
   - Kept rent goes into the rent month as received. That is legally important: its NK part then counts as prepayment in the tenant's last NK-Abrechnung, so the tenant does not pay it twice.
   - Rentals has no "Who pays › Schaden › Direct" until D40 is built. Until then a kept damage in Rentals has no clean place in Controlling.
10. Casa "Add a tenant to this NK" (a tenant not in the app) never reaches Controlling, even by bank transfer. The code says this is deliberate (settlements-tab-casa.js:2546, "no booking in Controlling – just mark it"), so it is not listed as a bug. Under R2 the owner may still want those Nachzahlungen counted.
11. Older decisions that R1-R4 now replace:
    - D14 "Kaution never", in its reading that a Kaution offset is information only;
    - the controlling-abr.js header "settled via Kaution → once, as information";
    - B20's optional "bank transfer" instead of the offset.
    The B20 comments already meant Controlling to get the full NK result.
12. The two checks disagreed on the Money step text: the Rentals check said not a bug (the calculation shows the transfer), the settle-flow check said real (Casa never shows it). I merged them into KAU-6. It is real for Casa, and the wording is misleading in both apps.

How the Rentals Kaution works today (frozen tree 511dbef):

1. AGREED. kaution.js sets the rule. A flat with Kalt + NK pays 3× the Kaltmiete, a Pauschal flat 3× the Pauschale, a parking spot 3× the Parkmiete, a Kurzzeit stay of up to 3 months 1× (longer: 3×), and Gewerbe 3×. The rule is overridden by "Individuelle Kaution" on the unit card (Apartments / Parking › Miete) while its switch is on, and by a value typed into the generator for that one PDF. The contracts say the Kaution is "sofort nach Vertragsunterzeichnung" fällig, and the Mietvertrag §7 says it is kept on a separate Kautionskonto (§ 551 BGB). Approve saves the amount once as rnt_tenant_records.kaution_soll ("Fest seit Einzug"). Older active tenants get it filled once by _rntFreezeKautionSoll. After that it changes only by hand: Kaution Soll in the Kaution form or in the profile.

2. RECEIVED. Tenants › unit card › Kaution section is cc-kaution-card.js, shared with Casa, with 5 phases. Edit → "Received" + "Received on" goes to rnt_kaution.received / received_at. If no row exists, _rntEnsureKaution creates it first. The pill shows "Kaution X open" until the Soll is received, then "Kaution ✓". The top summary line shows "Kaution held" = the sum of (received − returned) over all rows that are not settled.

3. ACCOUNT / BÜRGSCHAFT / INTEREST. The app stores nothing about the Kautionskonto, a bank guarantee or interest. The Mietbürgschaft is only an optional last PDF page (cc-buergschaft.js) and carries no data or money.

4. MOVE-OUT. When the tenant is former, or the move-out date has passed, the form opens by itself (phase 4 "Settle"). It has these fields:
   - Kept · other reasons, with a Reason (rent owed, damages …)
   - Kept · for NK-Abrechnung (rnt_kaution.nk_einbehalt, e.g. 300 €)
   - Refund to tenant = Received − kept. Typing either side calculates the other.
   - Refunded on

   Save writes received/returned in one call (_rntSaveKaution), then nk_einbehalt / deduction_reason / settled / settled_at in a second call. A refund without "Refunded on" counts as "still held", but the tab's held total and the Former pills already subtract it. "Refunded on" filled = settled. Archive is allowed only once the Kaution is settled.

5. NK OFFSET (the only place the Kaution touches Settlements). Settlements › Rentals (_srEinbehalt) reads nk_einbehalt of a SETTLED Kaution row and offers it to the tenant's NK-Abrechnung once, while "Settle by" stays on "via Kaution" (the default whenever an Einbehalt exists).
   - The calculation shows "Kaution held back 300 € · pay back to the tenant 100 € / tenant still pays 150 €".
   - The letter (nk-letter.js) says "mit dem einbehaltenen Teil der Mietkaution verrechnet" and asks for, or promises, a bank transfer of the rest.
   - Mark as sent writes abr_results with amount = the full NK result and settle_via 'kaution'.
   - The Money step then only confirms ("Received" / "Paid back" → ctrl_settlements erledigt, settled_via 'kaution') and books nothing.

   "Settle by" also offers "bank transfer", "with the rent" and "via Kaution" for ANY result, even when no Kaution is held. Choosing "via Kaution" has no link to the Kaution card. "undo" on the settled Money step rewrites settle_via to 'zahlung'.

6. CONTROLLING. It never reads rnt_kaution. Receiving and refunding the Kaution never show anywhere, which fits R1. An NK result with settle_via 'kaution' appears only as a grey info row ("settled with Kaution – no payment") and counts 0 in Income/Expenses, Dashboard and export. "Kept · other reasons" (rent owed, damages) never reaches Controlling. Income rows offer the "On purpose" reason "Kaution" for any rent difference. It is only a label, so an Ist that includes a Kaution is marked neutral and counted as rent.

7. SQL. rnt_kaution has received, returned, settled, settled_at, received_at, deduction_reason, and nk_einbehalt (added by SETTLEMENTS-RENTALS.sql). ctrl_settlements.settled_via is limited to ('zahlung','kaution') (UPDATE.sql); abr_results.settle_via holds the same values. RENTALS-CHECK.sql only checks for a Gewerbe Kaution Soll of 0 (owner: done, clean). Deleting a tenant also deletes their rnt_kaution row.

Remove 'Kaution' from Controlling's 'On purpose' reasons (controlling-ui.js:404 CX_DIFF_IN, controlling-data.js:79), so a Kaution can never be marked as a neutral part of the rent (R1, R4).

When the Kaution is settled ('Refunded on' saved) with 'Kept · other reasons' > 0 (rent owed, damages), write ONE Controlling income line: ctrl_expense_one_time, direction +1, item 'Kaution kept · <reason> · <tenant>', date = Refunded on, source_ref 'kaution:<rnt_kaution.id>'. map.workflow_today:
I read the Casa Kaution code in the frozen tree (511dbef): kaution.js, cc-kaution-card.js (shared with Rentals), cc-tenant-status.js, tab-tenants.js, cc-generator.js / cc-contract-flow.js / cc-contract-master.js, cc-buergschaft.js, and every place the `kaution` table is used in settlements-tab-casa.js, nk-letter.js and controlling-*.js. This is the workflow as it runs today.

1. HOW MUCH (Kaution Soll). One rule in kaution.js:
   - Mietvertrag / Jahresvertrag: 3× Kaltmiete, or 3× Pauschalmiete for a Pauschal room.
   - Kurzzeit: 1× up to 3 months, 3× when the stay is longer. Checked: 01.10.–31.12. with 750 € Pauschal gives 750 €; 01.10.–15.01. gives 2.250 €.
   - A room can have an individual Kaution (Rooms card switch, Jahres- / Mietvertrag only).
   - The generator puts the amount in the contract PDF (§ 6 "Kaution": due right after signing, paid by transfer, kept on a Treuhandkonto; damages the tenant caused are taken 100 % from the Kaution; the rest is paid back after the move-out check).
   - A renewal says "bereits geleistet". The optional Mietbürgschaft page says it comes on top of the Kaution.
   - On Approve the amount is stored on the tenant as `tenant_records.kaution_soll` (fixed for the tenancy). Older tenants get it filled once when the tab loads. A Kurzzeit stay without an end date waits.

2. RECEIVING. Tenants › tenant card › Kaution › Edit: Received + Received on → Save.
   - This writes `kaution.received` and `received_at`. The row is created the first time.
   - Header pill: "Kaution open", "X € open", or "Kaution 1.800 €" (green).
   - The IST card shows "Kaution held" (received − returned of every unsettled row) and "Kaution missing · n".
   - Nothing goes to Controlling.

3. MOVE-OUT. Once the tenant is former (or the move-out date has passed), the Kaution form opens by itself (pill "Settle"). Fields:
   - Received, Received on
   - Kept · other reasons + Reason
   - Kept · for NK-Abrechnung
   - Refund to tenant, Refunded on

   The refund and "other reasons" calculate each other. Save writes to the `kaution` table:
   - `returned` = the refund
   - `nk_einbehalt` = the NK part
   - `deduction_reason`
   - `settled` = "Refunded on" is filled, plus `settled_at`

   "Kept · other reasons" is not stored as its own number (it is received − returned − nk_einbehalt). Once settled:
   - the card says "Settled";
   - the former row says "Kaution X € returned";
   - the row drops out of "Kaution held" and "Kaution to settle";
   - Archive / Delete are allowed.

4. SETTLEMENTS. settlements-tab-casa.js reads the whole `kaution` table. When a Kaution is settled and has `nk_einbehalt` > 0, the tenant's next Kalt+NK NK letter (not Pauschal, and not already used by another NK sent "via Kaution") defaults to "via Kaution" and offsets that amount:
   - Nachzahlung ≤ held part: the rest of the held part goes back by bank transfer.
   - Nachzahlung > held part: the tenant is asked to transfer the rest.
   - Guthaben: Guthaben + held part go back by transfer.
   - 0: the held part goes back.

   Mark as sent writes `abr_results` with the full NK amount (direction + |saldo|) and `settle_via` 'kaution'. The Money step says "Dan pays you 450 € · via Kaution" with no amount field. "Received" / "Paid back" only marks the line done (`ctrl_settlements.status` 'erledigt'). It books nothing. "Settle by" also offers "via Kaution" without any held part, and "with the rent". The Kaution card never learns about either.

5. CONTROLLING. It never reads the `kaution` table, so receiving, holding and returning a Kaution count nowhere.
   - An NK result with `settle_via` 'kaution' shows only as an information row ("450,00 € · settled with Kaution – no payment"). It counts 0 in Income, Expenses, Dashboard and export.
   - "Kept · other reasons" (damage, rent owed) never reaches Controlling.
   - Income "On purpose" offers the reason "Kaution". It can mark a rent shortfall (the rent is then never counted) or a plus difference (a Kaution typed into the rent Ist then counts as income).

map.workflow_today:
How the Kaution and the NK settlement work today, in plain words. Both apps behave the same way: Casa = settlements-tab-casa.js, Rentals = settlements-tab-rentals.js.

1. The only automatic link. In Tenants › Kaution the owner can mark part of the Kaution as "Kept · for NK-Abrechnung" (column nk_einbehalt, e.g. 300 €). Settlements reads it only once that Kaution is marked settled (scEinbehalt / _srEinbehalt). The amount is offered once, to whichever NK letter of that tenant comes first. The "once" rule looks for another NK period of the same tenant whose result was settled "via Kaution". If it finds one, the kept amount counts as used, even when that other result had nothing to do with the kept amount.

2. Tenant sheet, "Settle by". Three buttons: bank transfer / with the rent / via Kaution. Default: via Kaution when an amount is kept, otherwise bank transfer. The owner can choose "with the rent" or "via Kaution" for any tenant, also for one who has moved out or whose Kaution was already returned in full.

3. Mark as sent writes three things:
   - the PDF letter (nk_letters)
   - the settlement line (ctrl_settlements: status 'verschickt', settled_via)
   - the result (abr_results): direction, the FULL NK result |S|, settle_via ('kaution' whenever an amount is kept), due date = letter date + 30 days.

   The letter (nk-letter.js) says, with an amount E kept and result S:
   - S ≤ E: "Die Nachzahlung wird mit dem einbehaltenen Teil … (E) verrechnet. Der Restbetrag von E−S wird dir … zurücküberwiesen".
   - S > E: "… verrechnet. Bitte überweise uns den Restbetrag von S−E …".
   - Guthaben: "Das Guthaben und der einbehaltene Teil … zusammen A+E, werden dir … zurücküberwiesen".
   - Balanced: "Der einbehaltene Teil … von E wird dir … zurücküberwiesen".
   - Nothing kept, via Kaution: "… mit deiner Mietkaution verrechnet – du musst nichts überweisen" / "… bei der Abrechnung deiner Mietkaution berücksichtigt".
   - With the rent: "… zusammen mit der nächsten Miete" / "Überweise die nächste Miete … gekürzt".

4. Money step.
   - Bank transfer: the step has a date and an amount. "Received" / "Paid back" writes one booking in Controlling (ctrl_expense_one_time, kind NK-Abrechnung, source_ref abr:<id>, the typed amount and date). Before that, Controlling › Income/Expenses › Abrechnungen shows an open Soll in the due month, which moves along "due since …" while overdue.
